verdict.rationale: INPI publishes public guidance pages for filing a trademark, design, patent, provisional patent, utility certificate, e-Soleau and PPH request, plus examination guidelines (directives). These pages appear to be readable on inpi.fr without an account. However, nothing in the evidence shows the forms themselves are downloadable without logging in, and the patent page points to online filing instead. missing for 10: evidence of account-free downloadable forms (e.g. PDF/Cerfa), explicit confirmation that instructions are downloadable rather than just viewable web pages, hands-on or independent corroboration of account-free access.
